docs.description: Use for architecture, database schema, auth flow, deployment, and SRS docs

roadmap.description: Use for implementation status and phased plan

architect.description: Architecture & design advisor. Use when making structural decisions, choosing technologies, designing data flow, or reviewing system design. Provides reasoned recommendations with trade-off analysis.

advisor.description: Code quality & production readiness review. Use for PR reviews, security audits, performance analysis, and best-practice enforcement. Read-only — identifies issues without making changes.

quality.description: Testing & QA specialist. Writes unit tests, integration tests, and E2E tests. Handles test setup, fixtures, and coverage analysis.

db.description: Database & data layer specialist. Handles schema design, migrations, seed scripts, query optimization, and data access layer implementation.

review.description: Run a full code review on recent changes. Pass optional scope: 'all', 'stage', or 'files <paths>'
review.template:
Review the following code for quality, security, performance, and adherence to project conventions. Focus on: TypeScript strictness, error handling, data validation (Zod), authentication guards, and server/client component boundaries.

$ARGUMENTS

typecheck.description: Run TypeScript check and lint together
typecheck.template: Run npm run build to typecheck and compile, and npm run lint for linting. Fix any errors found.

seed.template:
Run the database seed script at lib/db/seed.ts using: npm run db:seed
If tsx is not installed, install it first. Verify the seed succeeded by checking the database.

migrate.template: Run drizzle-kit generate to create migration files, then drizzle-kit migrate to apply them. Apply the full-text search migration SQL file separately. Verify the schema is up to date.
